{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any non-numeric revenue values
non_numeric_revenue = df[~df['revenue'].notna()]

# Check the distribution of revenue for completed orders
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
completed_revenue_mean = completed_orders['revenue'].mean()

non_numeric_revenue.shape[0], completed_revenue_mean"}
